items.title: Authenticated shell and health status
items.notes: Actual authentication, workspace switching and health probes are excluded. Exporting the existing context permits route reuse without mounting the authenticated provider; no copied shell is presented as real UI.

items.title: Media pipeline and provider outcomes
items.notes: Synthetic SVG previews, empty/queued/failed/succeeded export cards and request failures cover presentation only. Video playback, signed downloads, successful upload, real generation, account permissions, persistence and export acceptance remain release/integration tests.

items.title: Server-side mutations and validation
items.notes: Save, delete, approve, clone, generate and authorization API actions fail closed in this fixture. Local form editing, navigation within a screen, keyboard operation and reset are exercised. No backend acceptance claim.

items.title: Unused alternate storytelling landing
items.notes: Current production entry uses RiverLanding. Alternate unused landing is not presented as an active product screen.
